sentence: A 35-year-old woman comes to the clinic due to poor visual acuity (VA) since childhood, without treatment.

The examination revealed yellowish hair, as well as eyebrows and eyelashes; reddish skin, without nevi; corrected visual acuity of 20/400 (-9.50 -5.50 x 135º) in the right eye (RE) and 20/200 (-6.50 -5.50 x 20º) in the left eye (LE); exotropia of 50 diopters, horizontal nystagmus; both eyes (AO) with intraocular pressure of 12 mmHg, normal conjunctiva, cornea with some well-circumscribed central and anterior whitish stromal deposits, anterior chamber without cells or flare, clear iris with transillumination, transparent lens and foveal hypoplasia.
With the ocular and systemic clinical data, the diagnoses of AOC and GD were established and the family was summoned for clinical evaluation.
It is a family of nine members, with parents aged 74 and 64.
There is no consanguinity and they come from different locations.
GD is present in the mother, three brothers and her son, while AOC appears in two of the brothers but without data on GD.
